subject: MerchSmith renewal: tier reshuffle and competitive bakeoff
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@merchsmith.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: MerchSmith Procurement <procurement@merchsmith.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@merchsmith.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussions + bakeoff request (MerchSmith)

Tessa / Jordan —

Quick note to get the renewal/upsell conversation started. Our contract is up in September and we've been approached by another vendor offering a lower headline price for inference. Before we make any calls I'd like to run a short bakeoff focused on our peak holiday profile (spiky QPS, 200–250 concurrent inference requests, 1.5k token average). Two asks from our side:

- Can you commit to a bakeoff window in the next two weeks?
- If performance meets our bar, we want an upsell path for a 50% capacity uplift and a refreshed tier structure for predictable unit economics.

Procurement (cc'd) will need a redline-ready term sheet if we decide to move forward. We're sensitive to both latency and cost; the competitor is aggressive on price but opaque on throughput guarantees.

Available windows: Jul 16–20 or Jul 23–26. Prefer earlier.

Thanks —
Samir
Director of Engineering, MerchSmith
[attachment: expected_qps.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@merchsmith.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, MerchSmith Procurement <procurement@merchsmith.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + bakeoff request (MerchSmith)

Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and the windows. We can absolutely run a focused bakeoff and validate against your holiday profile. Proposal:

- Scope: 3-day instrumented bakeoff with your representative queries + synthetic spike tests. We'll capture p50/p95/p99 latency, end-to-end tail, and token cost delta versus current baseline.
- Success criteria (suggested): p95 <= 140ms on your profile, error rate <0.2%, and steady-state unit cost within 10% of baseline. We can adjust based on your sample.
- Offer during evaluation: temporary uplift (dedicated burst pool) for the test window + a save package if metrics pass (one-month bill credit + price floor for 12 months).

Available: Jul 16–18 (preferred) or Jul 24–26. We'll aim for Jul 16 start — if you confirm supplier access and a sample traffic dump by Fri (Jul 13) we'll provision a dedicated slot.

I've attached a draft terms outline for procurement to review.

—Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: proposed_terms_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@merchsmith.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@merchsmith.com>, MerchSmith Procurement <procurement@merchsmith.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + bakeoff request (MerchSmith)

Tessa —

Quick clarifying items from procurement/ops so we can scope the bakeoff properly:

- Can you provide SOC 2 evidence and the last three months of audit log samples for inference calls?
- What guarantees are you offering on throughput for the temporary uplift? We need to validate you can hit 200 req/s sustained for at least the 3-day test.
- Please confirm what data isolation model will be used for this test (we can only run test traffic that is isolated).

Also please send a checklist of success metrics in a single doc so procurement can sign off quickly. Timeline is tight — we need the terms redline and a demo to present to the exec committee by the 26th.

Thanks,
Alicia
Senior Procurement Manager, MerchSmith
[attachment: merch_bakeoff_requirements.docx (docx)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@merchsmith.com>, Samir Shah <samir@merchsmith.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, MerchSmith Procurement <procurement@merchsmith.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + bakeoff request (MerchSmith)

Alicia / Samir —

We ran a dry run on a copy of your sample corpus yesterday and attached the preliminary microbench. High level: on the sample we saw p95 at ~118ms and p99 at ~230ms under a simulated 180 req/s burst. Cost per 1k tokens was ~12% better than your current vendor on our dedup+kv-cache path. Full caveats in the CSV.

Based on that, here's a proposed save package if you choose Redwood post-bakeoff:

- Dedicated pilot pool (3 months) sized to your 50% uplift requirement with autoscale headroom.
- 15% credit on the first invoice after go-live (applied as one-time credit).
- Pricing floor for 12 months (no increases beyond X% without 60 days notice).
- SLA backstop: if p95 exceeds 160ms for two consecutive weeks we offer a remediation credit equal to 10% of monthly usage and a guaranteed engineering escalation path.

Attachments: bench_results.csv (instrumentation), draft_proposed_terms_v2.pdf.

If procurement signs off on SOC 2 evidence and audit logs (we can provide redacted samples and an attestation), we can schedule the instrumented bakeoff for Jul 24–26 and provision the pilot pool the week of Jul 29 to minimize disruption.

-Jordan
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
[attachment: bench_results.csv (csv)] [attachment: proposed_terms_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Shah <samir@merchsmith.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@merchsmith.com>, MerchSmith Procurement <procurement@merchsmith.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + bakeoff request (MerchSmith)

Jordan / Tessa —

Thanks for the bench — encouraging numbers. Procurement needs the SOC 2 evidence and audit log samples before we can run the live test; Alicia, can you confirm what redaction level you need and we'll ask Redwood to provide that today.

Two urgent asks from the exec team:

1) A short recorded demo (5–8 minutes) showing the dedicated pilot provisioning and a simulated spike so we can present on the 26th.
2) A redlineable term sheet we can hand to legal; safety and liability must be explicit for the pilot window.

If Redwood can deliver those two items by COB Jul 24 we'll keep the Jul 24–26 window. If not, we will have to surface the competitor option to the board as they are pushing for a decision.

-Samir
Director of Engineering, MerchSmith
[attachment: priority_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@merchsmith.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@merchsmith.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, MerchSmith Procurement <procurement@merchsmith.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 16:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussions + bakeoff request (MerchSmith)

Samir / Alicia —

Appreciate the urgency — quick status and the save path we can commit to now:

What you'll get by COB Jul 24 (delivered):
- Demo recording: 6m video showing dedicated pilot provisioning + simulated spike (link below).
- SOC 2 attestation and redacted audit log samples (sent to procurement).
- Redline-ready terms (proposed_terms_v2.pdf) with explicit pilot liability language.

Contingent save package (if bakeoff passes your success criteria):
- 12-month renewal extension at an adjusted tier that covers a 50% capacity uplift.
- 15% first-invoice credit (applied as one-time credit).
- 3-month dedicated pilot (no extra infra charge during pilot).
- Performance SLA: p95 <= 120ms on your validated profile; remediation credit if not met.
- Dedicated Customer Success + weekly triage during first 8 weeks.

Next steps: Confirm Jul 24–26 instrumented window and procurement acceptance of the attestation. I will open a DocuSign for the pilot terms so procurement can do a quick redline (link below). If you want, we can also offer a one-time migration engineering kickoff credit to accelerate onboarding.

Thank you — we're focused on keeping MerchSmith in production with no drop in availability during your busiest quarter.

—Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | tessa@redwood.com | (555) 867-1200
